Matched 1.5 uA PMOS injectors push current into Rs (vref side) and into the divider Thevenin resistance (Rth = Rs), so the shift cancels exactly. This gives an NMOS-pair and tail headroom of 0.25 V or more at ss/-40C/1.62 V. The OTA drives the pass gate directly. Miller Cc gives a dominant pole and coupling for fast undershoot response. A 40 uA bleed raises light-load gm_pass so p2 stays above the UGB. Iq is about 60 uA."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":   (16.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # input pair gm/Id (moderate/weak inversion)
    "L_ota":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # OTA / bias channel length
    "I_tail":    (4e-6, 2e-6, 10e-6),    # OTA tail current
    "I_inj":     (1.5e-6, 0.7e-6, 4e-6), # level-shift injector current (each)
    "V_sh":      (0.40, 0.30, 0.50),     # input common-mode shift above 0.6 V
    "I_bleed":   (40e-6, 15e-6, 45e-6),  # internal minimum load through pass device
    "Cc":        (20e-12, 8e-12, 40e-12),# Miller cap gate->vout
    "Rz":        (6e3, 1e3, 30e3),       # nulling resistor
    "gmid_pass": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # pass gm/Id at ss/-40C full load (start value)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6)
    vout_t = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)
    imax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3)
    imin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-9)
    iref = 10e-6
    L = p["L_ota"]
    It = p["I_tail"]; Ii = p["I_inj"]; Ip0 = 2e-6
    gmb = 14.0                      # common gm/Id for NMOS bias mirror family

    # ---------------- bias network ----------------
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmb, L, iref, vds=0.6)            # ibias diode
    mt  = lut.size("n", gmb, L, It, vds=0.3)              # OTA tail
    mb1 = lut.size("n", gmb, L, Ip0, vds=0.6)             # sinks PMOS bias diode
    mp0 = lut.size("p", 12.0, L, Ip0, vds=0.9)            # PMOS bias diode
    mpi = lut.size("p", 12.0, L, Ii, vds=0.6)             # injectors (drain ~1.0 V)

    # ---------------- level-shift / divider ----------------
    vcm = vref + p["V_sh"]
    Rth = p["V_sh"] / Ii            # Thevenin R of divider = Rs  -> exact cancellation
    Rd = 2.0 * Rth                  # R1 = R2 (beta = 0.5 for 1.2 V from 0.6 V)
    Rs = Rth
    beta = vref / vout_t

    # ---------------- OTA ----------------
    m_in = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], L, It / 2, vds=0.45, vsb=0.45)
    m_ld = lut.size("p", 10.0, L, It / 2, vds=0.75)
    A_ota = m_in.gm / (m_in.gds + m_ld.gds)

    # worst-case headroom (ss, -40C): input Vgs rises ~0.12 V
    vgs_in_wc = m_in.vgs + 0.12
    v_tail_wc = vcm - vgs_in_wc
    y_min = v_tail_wc + 0.12        # lowest usable gate drive voltage
    vsg_lim = 1.62 - y_min - 0.05

    # ---------------- pass device sized at ss/-40C, VIN=1.62 ----------------
    wc = lut.at("ss", -40)
    g = p["gmid_pass"]
    mp = None
    while g <= 20.0:
        try:
            cand = wc.size("p", g, 0.15, 1.15 * imax, vds=0.4)
        except Exception:
            break
        mp = cand
        if cand.vgs <= vsg_lim and cand.W <= 4800:
            break
        g += 0.5
    if mp is None:
        mp = wc.size("p", 14.0, 0.15, 1.15 * imax, vds=0.4)
    nf = max(1, min(200, int(math.ceil(mp.W / 100.0))))

    # ---------------- netlist ----------------
    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("Mb0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("Mt",  "tail",  "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("Mb1", "pb",    "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("Mp0", "pb",    "pb",    "vin", "vin", mp0)
    # injectors + level shift
    n.dev("Mi1", "fb",   "pb", "vin", "vin", mpi)
    n.dev("Mi2", "nref", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpi)
    n.R("Rs", "nref", "vref", Rs)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", Rd)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", Rd)
    # OTA: fb on diode side -> correct loop polarity driving pass gate directly
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "fb",   "tail", "vss", m_in)
    n.dev("M2", "g",  "nref", "tail", "vss", m_in)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vin", "vin", m_ld)
    n.dev("M4", "g",  "d1", "vin", "vin", m_ld)
    # pass device
    n.dev("Mpass", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", mp, m=nf)
    # compensation
    n.R("Rz", "g", "nc", p["Rz"])
    n.C("Cc", "nc", "vout", p["Cc"])
    # bleed (minimum pass current -> keeps p2 above UGB at light load)
    n.R("Rb", "vout", "vss", vout_t / p["I_bleed"])

    # ---------------- predictions ----------------
    iq = iref + Ip0 + It + 2 * Ii + vout_t / (2 * Rd) + p["I_bleed"]
    cg = mp.cgg * 1.0
    kc = p["Cc"] / (p["Cc"] + cg)
    ugb = beta * m_in.gm / (2 * PI * p["Cc"])
    i_light = imin + p["I_bleed"] + vout_t / (2 * Rd)
    gm_light = i_light / (1.35 * 0.0343)              # weak inversion, 125C worst
    p2 = gm_light / (2 * PI * cl) * kc
    pm = 90.0 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugb / p2))
    T1k = ugb / 1e3
    psrr = db(1.0 + T1k)
    # load regulation: gate swing across load range / (beta*A_ota) / dI
    dvsg = 1.4 * 0.0343 * math.log(imax / i_light) + 0.15
    load_reg = dvsg / (beta * A_ota) / (imax - imin)
    T_dc = beta * A_ota * mp.gm / (mp.gds + 1e-12)
    line_reg = 1.0 / max(T_dc, 1.0) + 1e-3
    undershoot = dvsg / kc * 0.9
    vout_err = 100.0 * (1.0 / (beta * A_ota * 20) + 0.002)
    return n, {
        "iq": iq,
        "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "vout_err_pct": vout_err,
        "ripple_settled": 0.003,
        "ugb_hz": ugb, "p2_light_hz": p2, "pm_deg": pm,
        "pass_W": mp.W, "pass_vsg_wc": mp.vgs, "vsg_lim": vsg_lim,
        "tail_v_wc": v_tail_wc, "A_ota": A_ota,
    }
